title: Care for Syphilis-exposed infants
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS
Management of Adult and Adolescent Living with HIV with Antiretroviral Therapy

blocks.text: All infants born to mothers with Syphilis infection should:
Carefully be assessed for manifestations of congenital syphilis.
Ensure proper treatment to infants diagnosed with congenital syphilis (Refer section 5.8.2.1 for management of Congenital Syphilis in National Guideline for Management of HIV, STIs and Hepatitis)
